sourceNotes.rawContent:
- A sleek and modern open band ring that blends minimalism with sparkle. Crafted from durable stainless steel with 18K gold plating, one side of the band shines with delicate stone studs while the other side stays plain for a classy contrast.
- With its anti-tarnish finish and adjustable fit, this ring is perfect for everyday wear or special occasions, adding effortless elegance to your style.
- Product: Anti-Tarnish Open Band Ring
- Material: Stainless steel
- Plating: 18K gold tone plating
- Finish: Anti-tarnish (long-lasting shine)
- Design: Open band with one plain & one stone-studded end
- Fit: Adjustable – fits any finger
- Style: Minimalist, modern & versatile
- Comfort: Lightweight & smooth finish
- Occasions: Daily wear, casual outings, parties, gifting
sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Anti-Tarnish Gold-Plated Open Adjustable Stone-Studded Ring
